hook_text: Twelve taxi passengers, R25 each. Count it in six seconds without adding one rand at a time.
clip_script: A taxi at the rank in Durban. Each passenger pays R25. Do not count in ones. Jump: 25, 50, 75, 100, 125, 150, 175, 200, 225, 250, 275, 300. Twelve passengers, R300. Hear the endings? 25, 50, 75, 00, round and round. Now the stadium: rows of 50 seats, 2 000 people, one row leaves at a time. 2 000, 1 950, 1 900, 1 850. Same jump, other direction. The tricky moment is crossing a thousand going down: 3 050 back 100 is 2 950, not 3 950. Thousands digit drops, hundreds digit becomes 9. Gap in a sequence? Find the jump from two neighbours, check it on another pair, fill the gap. Counting in steps is multiplication in disguise.
visual_style: Whiteboard taxi with R25 coins stacking into a running total; a stadium grid losing one row at a time; a number line with equal jumps.
mood: Quick, rhythmic, like a counting song.
pacing: Fast taxi count, then the backwards stadium count, then the one tricky crossing and the one-line rule.
call_to_action: Watch the full lesson and count the coins in your pocket in 25s.
